Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was not released under Roc-A-Fella and switched the answer to Graduation, despite the just-opened Wikipedia page for “Power” explicitly showing the label as Roc-A-Fella/Def Jam and confirming Dwele’s vocals on the MBDTF single. This misinterpretation led to the wrong final album.
